faq.subtext: Everything you need to know before you subscribe.

items.q1: What is 8KPRIME and how does it work?
items.a1: 8KPRIME is a premium streaming service that delivers 60,000+ live channels and 160,000+ movies & series directly to your device via an internet connection. No satellite dish or cable box needed — just pick a plan, pay, and start watching within minutes.
items.a2: We support virtually every device: Smart TVs (Samsung, LG, Sony), Amazon Firestick, Android TV, Apple TV, iPhone, iPad, Android phones & tablets, Windows PC, Mac, and MAG/Formuler boxes.
items.q3: How fast will I get access after payment?
items.a3: Activation is instant. After payment, you'll receive your login credentials and setup instructions via email within 2-5 minutes. In rare cases, it may take up to 30 minutes.
items.a4: Absolutely. We use SSL-encrypted checkout with bank-level security. We accept PayPal (with buyer protection), credit/debit cards, and cryptocurrency. Your financial data is never stored on our servers.
items.q5: What if I'm not satisfied? Can I get a refund?
items.a5: Yes. We offer a no-questions-asked 7-day money-back guarantee. If the service doesn't meet your expectations, contact our support team and receive a full refund — no hassle, no hidden conditions.
items.q6: Are there hidden fees or auto-renewals?
items.a6: No hidden fees, ever. The price you see is the price you pay. Your subscription does not auto-renew — when it expires, you simply choose whether to renew.
items.q7: Can I use one subscription on multiple devices?
items.a7: Yes! You choose the number of simultaneous connections when you subscribe — 1, 2, 3, or 4 devices. Each device can stream independently at the same time.
items.q8: What countries and channels are covered?
items.a8: We cover 115+ countries with channels from every major region: Europe, North America, Middle East, Asia, Africa, Latin America, and Oceania. All major sports leagues, news networks, and entertainment channels are included.

setup_guide.meta_desc: Learn how to set up 8KPRIME TV on your preferred device with our simple step-by-step tutorials.
setup_guide.subtext: Follow these professional tutorials to activate 8KPRIME TV on any device.
setup_guide.mac_address_banner: After installing the app, Open it and find your Device MAC Address. Send it to our elite support team via WhatsApp or Live Chat for instant activation.

android.name: ANDROID DEVICES
android.step1: Install the Downloader app by AFT News from the Google Play Store on your device.
android.step2: Open Downloader and enter one of the codes below. Press Go to download and install.
android.step3: Alternatively, you can search directly on the Play Store for any of the recommended apps below.

firestick.name: FIRESTICK & ANDROID TV
firestick.step1: Navigate to Settings → My Fire TV → Developer Options and enable ADB Debugging and Apps from Unknown Sources.
firestick.step2: From Home Screen, click Search and type "Downloader". Download and install the app (orange icon).
firestick.step3: Open Downloader and enter one of the codes below. Press Go to download and install.

smart_tv.name: SMART TVS (ALL BRANDS)
smart_tv.title: ALL SMART TVS
smart_tv.subtitle: WORKS ON EVERY SMART TV BRAND
smart_tv.step1: Navigate to your TV's built-in App Store — whether it's Samsung's Smart Hub, LG's Content Store, or the Apps section on any other brand.
smart_tv.step2: Search for and install any of these recommended apps:
smart_tv.step3: Click Install and wait for the download to complete.

apple.name: APPLE (IOS/APPLE TV)
apple.step1: Launch the App Store on your iPhone, iPad, or Apple TV.
apple.step2: Choose either app below and tap Get to install:

windows.name: WINDOWS PC
windows.step1: Choose any app below. Click to download the .zip file, then extract and install.
windows.step2: Locate the downloaded .zip file, right-click → Extract All, then run the installer.

macos.name: MACOS
macos.step1: Launch the App Store on your Mac.
macos.step2: Choose either app below and click Get to install:

linux.name: LINUX
linux.step1: Install a compatible streaming media player via your distribution's package manager.

mag.name: MAG BOX / STB
mag.step1: Go to Settings > System Settings > Servers > Portals.
mag.step2: Enter our Portal URL and provide your MAC address to our support team.

formuler.name: FORMULER Z
formuler.step1: Open the MYTVOnline app on your Formuler device.
formuler.step2: Add a new portal with the URL provided by our team.
